skills.skill_desc:
Valir's skills apply a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Ablaze</font> to enemies hit, dealing them <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> equal to 1<font color="62f8fe"> (+0.2% Total Magic Power)</font>% of their <font color="26e407"><1005></font> per second for 3s.

At 3 stacks, the fire detonates, dealing <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> equal to 5<font color="62f8fe"> (+1% Total Magic Power)</font>% of the target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font> and stunning them for 1s.
A target can only be stunned by Valir's skills once every 7s.

Valir launches a fireball that explodes upon hitting the first target, dealing 235<font color="62f8fe"> (+80% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and slowing them by 30% for 1s. The flame on the ground explodes after 1s, dealing 118<font color="62f8fe"> (+40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>.

Valir recharges 1 fireball every 9s (up to 2 charges). Hitting an enemy hero or legend creep with this skill immediately restores 1 charge, while hitting a minion restores 4s of the recharge time.

<font color="a6aafb">Vengeance Flame</font>: Increases the cast range of <font color="a6aafb">Burst Fireball</font> by 30%.

Valir unleashes a torrent of flames in the target direction, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and knocking them back to the end of its path.

<font color="a6aafb">Vengeance Flame</font>: The torrent forms a firewall at the end of its path that lasts 4s, dealing 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+30% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies every 1s.

Enemies hit by the torrent or the firewall are slowed by 25% for 1s.

Valir removes all debuffs on himself and gains 40% Movement Speed that decays over 3s. Meanwhile, he conjures 4 <font color="a6aafb">Vengeance Flames</font> that enhance <font color="a6aafb">Burst Fireball</font> and <font color="a6aafb">Searing Torrent</font> for 9s.
